## Frequently asked questions

### Setup

#### What Excel setup do I need?

Use Excel with English function names, commas between function arguments, and periods as decimal separators. Follow the [Excel language settings guide](student_guide/language-settings.qmd) to configure and check your setup.

#### Why do Excel formulas from the course sometimes not work on my computer?

The course formulas use English function names, commas as argument separators, and periods as decimal separators. If your settings differ, use the [Excel language settings guide](student_guide/language-settings.qmd) to fix them.

#### What do I need for Python?

You need Python and the course's Anaconda environment. Follow the setup and installation instructions provided through Canvas.

#### Do I need both Python and Anaconda?

Python is the programming language and runtime. Anaconda is a distribution that installs Python together with useful tools and packages. For this course, use the Anaconda setup provided through Canvas rather than installing the components separately.

### Exam

#### How is the course assessed?

There is a 40-minute Excel exam worth 40 points and an 80-minute Python exam worth 80 points. Both are paper-based exams.

#### Can I use aids such as a calculator, laptop, Excel, or Python during the exam?

No. You will write Excel formulas on paper in the Excel exam and Python code on paper in the Python exam. Calculators, laptops, Excel, Python, and other aids are not permitted.

#### Are past exams or mock exams available?

A mock exam will be provided for the Excel part through Canvas. Check Canvas for mock exams and related exam-preparation materials for the Python part.

### General course questions

#### Where can I find the course materials?

Course materials, exercises, announcements, and relevant organizational information are provided through Canvas.

#### What if I miss a class?

Review the corresponding materials and exercises in Canvas and catch up independently.

#### Where will course announcements and updates be posted?

Course announcements and updates will be posted in Canvas.
